notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/caesar_small.jl, caesar_medium.jl,
# caesar_large.jl and caesar_huge.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl, branch arithmetic,
# commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5 (Apache License 2.0), which
# differ only in their text, each a prefix of the next: one program, the
# text's length LENGTH its argument. Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice ->
# @alea, the BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: caesar-small
# to caesar-huge.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr
const IGNORE_ERRORS = true
# the text's first LENGTH letters: 10 (caesar-small), 50 (medium), 100 (large), 250 (huge)
const LENGTH = 250
const TEXT = [9, 11, 8, 21, 20, 21, 2, 5, 2, 12, 13, 2, 22, 9, 11, 8, 0, 11, 20, 6, 6, 2, 7, 0, 5, 20, 7, 0, 14, 20, 0, 24, 12, 9, 9, 5, 12, 20, 11, 24, 20, 7, 24, 17, 9, 11, 24, 12, 12, 2, 15, 24, 6, 24, 20, 7, 12, 8, 25, 11, 24, 9, 11, 24, 12, 24, 7, 13, 2, 7, 0, 20, 7, 23, 11, 24, 20, 12, 8, 7, 2, 7, 0, 20, 21, 8, 14, 13, 9, 11, 8, 21, 20, 21, 2, 5, 2, 12, 13, 2, 22, 6, 8, 23, 24, 5, 12, 13, 1, 24, 22, 8, 6, 9, 14, 13, 20, 13, 2, 8, 7, 20, 5, 22, 1, 20, 5, 5, 24, 7, 0, 24, 8, 25, 9, 11, 8, 21, 20, 21, 2, 5, 2, 12, 13, 2, 22, 2, 7, 25, 24, 11, 24, 7, 22, 24, 11, 24, 6, 20, 2, 7, 12, 13, 1, 24, 9, 11, 2, 6, 20, 11, 18, 11, 8, 20, 23, 21, 5, 8, 22, 4, 25, 8, 11, 20, 9, 9, 5, 18, 2, 7, 0, 9, 9, 5, 12, 2, 7, 9, 11, 20, 22, 13, 2, 22, 24, 2, 7, 25, 24, 11, 24, 7, 22, 24, 2, 12, 25, 14, 7, 23, 20, 6, 24, 7, 13, 20, 5, 5, 18, 1, 20, 11, 23, 12, 8, 13, 1, 24, 11, 24, 2, 12, 7, 8, 8, 7, 24, 12]

model() = @alea begin
    char_freqs = [0.082, 0.018, 0.024, 0.04, 0.123, 0.022, 0.022, 0.066, 0.069, 0.001, 0.008, 0.045, 0.024, 0.069, 0.073, 0.018, 0.002, 0.055, 0.067, 0.092, 0.028, 0.009, 0.023, 0.001, 0.018, 0.001]
    key = uniform(DistUInt{7}, 0, 26)

    function sendChar(key::DistUInt{7}, c::DistUInt{7})
        gen = discrete(DistUInt{7}, char_freqs)
        enc = key + gen
        enc = ifelse(enc > DistUInt{7}(25), enc-DistUInt{7}(26), enc)
        observe(prob_equals(enc, c))
    end

    for char in TEXT[1:LENGTH]
        sendChar(key, DistUInt{7}(char))
    end
    key
end
